title: FOMC-cycle even weeks (Cieslak, Morse and Vissing-Jorgensen 2019) and mid-month flow, equity index futures; nested
definitions: trading-day count t relative to the FOMC statement day (t=0); week 0 = t in [-1, 3], week 2 = [9, 13], week 4 = [19, 23], week 6 = [29, 33] (paper's definition, days counted forward from the last meeting)
selection: best on 2010-06..2022-12 per family; enters only if > 0.3
judgement: current book (10 sleeves) + entrants, Sharpe-weighted on 2010-22; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 0.842
